title: Remove legacy Czech account auto-conversion to IBAN
description: Legacy Czech domestic account numbers are no longer auto-converted to IBAN at validation. Rows still holding the old format now reject with VAL-014. Withdrawn because the conversion could not be done reliably in every case and a mis-converted account pays the wrong person. Customers must update employee bank details to IBAN. Announced in 2026.5, three months ahead.

title: Include failing column name in rejection reports
description: Rejection reports now show the failing column name next to the error code.

title: Add cost centre filter to run detail screen
description: Run detail screen can now be filtered by cost centre.

title: Add self-service SFTP key rotation
description: Customers can rotate their own SFTP keys without raising a support case.

title: Add GET /runs/{id}/rejections
description: New endpoint, returns the rejected rows of a payroll run.

title: Hotfix: approval emails dropped for approvers with an apostrophe in their address
description: Address escaping in the notification service dropped any recipient whose local part contained an apostrophe.

title: Rotate SFTP host certificate
description: Scheduled rotation of the SFTP gateway host cert. One of the three gateway nodes didn't pick up the new cert until it was restarted.

title: Add preview mode to bulk employee import
description: Bulk employee import now reports how many records would change and how many would fail before anything is written.

title: Log changes to employee payment details
description: Changes to an employee's bank account are now written to the audit log with the user and timestamp.

title: Increase calculation worker pool
description: Doubles the worker pool for gross-to-net calculation ahead of the summer peak.

title: Move session store to the managed cache cluster
description: Moves web app sessions off the self-managed cache onto the managed cluster.

title: Move session store to the managed cache cluster (first attempt)
description: First attempt at the migration. Connection pool was sized wrong for the managed cluster, web tier ran out of connections under morning load. Backed out same day.

title: Flag legacy bank accounts in export and run detail
description: Employee export marks records still holding a legacy domestic account number, and a warning banner is shown on any run containing them. Issued with the deprecation notice for automatic conversion, which is removed in 2026.8.

title: Load Czech and Slovak public holiday calendars for 2027
description: Adds 2027 public holiday calendars, used for cut-off and value date calculation.

title: Upgrade API gateway to 3.4
description: Routine gateway upgrade. New version defaults to a shorter upstream idle timeout than before, cuts off long-running report requests.

title: Add reduced social insurance rates for DPP agreements
description: Implements the reduced contribution thresholds for DPP agreements.

title: Redesign payroll run detail screen
description: Rebuilds the run detail screen around per-employee status rather than per-file status.

title: Tighten period validation on submitted files
description: Period column must now match the run's pay period exactly. Files with a period from an adjacent month used to slip through and get paid against the wrong period; they now reject with VAL-013.

title: Add second banking partner for Slovak payments
description: Adds a second banking partner used for payments to Slovak accounts.

title: Annual statutory rate update for 2026
description: Updates income tax bands, insurance rates and the taxpayer credit for 2026.
